scope: single repo authority for whether any checked resource number is accepted as the Clifford-complete physical baseline

current_strict_candidate.reason: strict replayed-tail count still depends on unpromoted modular arithmetic and guard-capacity boundaries

guard_corrected_no_alias_candidate.reason: counts the clean-ladder zero-lift guard workspace if no aliasing/no-ancilla proof exists, but the corrected owner model is not yet promoted into the global primitive stream

conservative_hardening_target.reason: use the guard-corrected no-alias total as the conservative repo-wide hardening target while the accepted physical baseline gate is closed
not_claimed: not an accepted Clifford-complete physical baseline
not a fresh compressed/Groth16 proof claim

accepted_baseline_gate.policy: accepted_physical_baseline may be populated only when every gate row passes and the accepted totals are recomputed from that same primitive stream

rows.name: single_authoritative_primitive_stream
rows.required_to_close: Make the global flat primitive stream the only source for execution, liveness, owner capacity, and resource totals.

rows.name: guard_corrected_no_alias_capacity_promoted_into_liveness
rows.required_to_close: Promote the zero-lift guard capacity into the scheduled primitive liveness owner model or prove a concrete alias/no-ancilla predicate construction.

rows.name: modular_accumulator_source_uncompute_promoted
rows.required_to_close: Promote consume/fold/source-uncompute rows into the same scheduled primitive netlist used for the public peak calculation.

rows.name: no_abandoned_synthetic_arithmetic_scratch
rows.required_to_close: Replace synthetic modular-arithmetic scratch observations with concrete primitive wires, owners, liveness, and cleanup.

rows.name: publication_gate_allows_resource_headline
rows.required_to_close: Clear public-headline publication blockers before any accepted baseline is advertised outside the candidate layer.

forbidden_presentations_until_gate_close: do not present 1199, 1044, or 1968 logical qubits as the accepted physical baseline
do not present 2222 logical qubits as accepted; present it only as the conservative hardening target under review
do not run or advertise proof freshness until the cheap artifact gates and proof_status gates pass
required_to_publish: Promote zero-lift guard capacity into the scheduled primitive liveness owner model or prove an executable alias/no-ancilla construction.
Promote modular accumulator consume/fold/source-uncompute rows into the global scheduled primitive netlist.
Recompute public totals from the same primitive stream used by tests and ZKP input.
Only then rebuild proof inputs and proof bundles if a ZKP-backed release claim is desired.
